_doc: Mapping of Google Sheet course labels → DB (institution_name, program_name) pairs for historical admission backfill. Used by scripts/admission/import-historical-sheets.py to populate admission_historical_pivot for 2024-25 and 2025-26 cycles. Locked 2026-06-02 via interactive Director sign-off.

_decisions.b_ed: Single sheet B.Ed row maps to NEW aggregate program 'B.Ed (Historical Aggregate)' in JKKN College of Education (program_id dabfdd5b-159a-4029-89c0-056859051803). Created 2026-06-02 since DB had only 11 pedagogy-specific B.Ed program_ids and sheet did not distinguish pedagogy.
_decisions.ma_english_aided: Sheet 'M.A.English' routes to JKKN College of Arts and Science (Aided)'s NEW M.A. ENGLISH program (program_id 3698dd01-884e-4e65-8a38-afb4f550106b). Created 2026-06-02 since Aided historically held this program before Self took over; Aided did not previously have an M.A. ENGLISH program_id.
_decisions.self_aided_split: B.A.English, B.Sc (Maths), M.Com., M.Sc.Mathematics exist in BOTH Self and Aided. Director-locked split: 70% Self / 30% Aided per row. Counts round to nearest integer per date.
_decisions.nursing_synonyms: Sheet 'Paediatric Nursing' → DB 'MSC (Child Health Nursing)'. Sheet 'Psychiatric Nursing' → DB 'MSC (Mental Health Nursing)'. Curriculum-standard synonyms.
_decisions.lateral_entry: Engineering Lateral Entry rows share program_id with their Year-I siblings. The importer relies on sheet category-header context ('ENGINEERING - LATERAL ENTRY - II YEAR') to flag these distinct from UG-I, but admission_years.program_start_year is the same so they aggregate into one row.
